market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil at $108 and $6 diesel drive inflation higher, forcing Fed hawkishness. Expect volatility in equities, rising bond yields, and pressure on rate-sensitive sectors. Energy outperforms; consumer and growth lag. Credit markets show early stress via French inversion.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on energy, AI infrastructure, and EM/BRICS integration. Multi-year Iran war supports oil above $90. AI infrastructure demand (HDD, servers, sovereign stacks) sustains through 2027. Higher rates become structural, favoring value and dividend strategies. BRICS realignment creates new trade and capital flow opportunities.
